scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run check:runtime && tsc && vite build --mode cloudflare && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.131.0 deploy --keep-vars
scripts.build:android:web: npm run check:runtime && tsc && vite build --mode android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android:web && node scripts/prepare-android-assets.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
